import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'survived': [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    'pclass': [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    'sex': ['male', 'female', 'female', 'female', 'male'],
    'age': [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    'sibsp': [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    'parch': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'fare': [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    'embarked': ['S', 'C', 'S', 'S', 'S'],
    'class': ['Third', 'First', 'Third', 'First', 'Third'],
    'who': ['man', 'woman', 'woman', 'woman', 'man'],
    'adult_male': [True, False, False, False, True],
    'deck': ['', 'C', '', 'C', ''],
    'embark_town': ['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Southampton', 'Southampton', 'Southampton'],
    'alive': ['no', 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'],
    'alone': [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival by class and gender
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_data = df.groupby(['class', 'sex', 'alive']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival by Class and Gender')
ax1.set_xlabel('Class & Gender')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(title='Survived')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
for survived_status in df['alive'].unique():
    subset = df[df['alive'] == survived_status]
    ax2.hist(subset['age'], alpha=0.5, label=survived_status, 
             bins=10, color='#2ecc71' if survived_status == 'yes' else '#e74c3c')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.legend(title='Survived')

# 3. Fare vs Age colored by survival
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['age'], df['fare'], 
                      c=df['alive'].map({'yes': 1, 'no': 0}), 
                      cmap='coolwarm', alpha=0.8, s=100)
ax3.set_title('Fare vs Age (Colored by Survival)')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_ticks([0, 1])
cbar.set_ticklabels(['No', 'Yes'])
cbar.set_label('Survived')

# 4. Embarkation town distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
embark_counts = df['embark_town'].value_counts()
colors = ['#3498db', '#9b59b6', '#e67e22']
ax4.pie(embark_counts.values, labels=embark_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=colors[:len(embark_counts)], startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Passengers by Embarkation Town')

# 5. Family size analysis
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['alive'].apply(
    lambda x: (x == 'yes').sum() / len(x) * 100).reset_index()
ax5.bar(family_survival['family_size'], family_survival['alive'], 
        color='#2ecc71', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)')
ax5.set_xticks(family_survival['family_size'])

# 6. Class distribution with survival
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
class_data = df.groupby(['class', 'alive']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
class_data_percent = class_data.div(class_data.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100
x = np.arange(len(class_data_percent))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax6.bar(x - width/2, class_data_percent['no'], width, 
                label='No', color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax6.bar(x + width/2, class_data_percent['yes'], width, 
                label='Yes', color='#2ecc71', alpha=0.8)
ax6.set_title('Survival Percentage by Class')
ax6.set_xlabel('Class')
ax6.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)')
ax6.set_xticks(x)
ax6.set_xticklabels(class_data_percent.index)
ax6.legend(title='Survived')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
